abstract_model_result.scope: ABSTRACT CONTRACT MODEL ONLY; NOT native, E2E, hardware, beacon-security, independent-labor, or activation evidence

tests.name: test_01_typed_context_roundtrip_preserves_native_width_and_absence
tests.contract: Native ID/seed widths and canonical route absence are preserved.

tests.name: test_02_context_codec_rejects_noncanonical_truncation_trailing_and_version
tests.contract: Bounds and expected field order precede decoding native content.

tests.name: test_03_obligation_changes_only_with_native_duty_coordinates
tests.contract: Each native scope dimension changes O; changing result/seed does not.

tests.name: test_04_all_pinned_context_dimensions_bind_without_minting_new_obligation
tests.contract: Root/profile/role/fee/plan changes cannot buy a new native duty.

tests.name: test_05_native_seed_tail_is_bound_and_truncation_rejected
tests.contract: The 64-byte native beacon tail affects nonce; 32-byte truncation fails.

tests.name: test_06_plan_spec_is_preselection_and_not_a_circular_target_commit
tests.contract: Context PlanSpec is fixed before seed and target derivation.

tests.name: test_07_subject_excludes_signature_bytes_but_native_auth_remains_required
tests.contract: Re-signing changes neither submission identity nor obligations.

tests.name: test_08_wrong_panel_or_key_cannot_relabel_a_completed_envelope
tests.contract: Copying A's whole Court to B fails before B's duty is consumed.

tests.name: test_09_client_nonce_round_step_anchor_or_seed_cannot_reroll
tests.contract: The packet cannot change the native slot or fixed challenge.

tests.name: test_10_seed_order_and_ready_cut_are_strict_without_guilt_or_clock_reset
tests.contract: Precommit or late seed is unavailable, not computational guilt.

tests.name: test_11_negative_nonce_does_not_wait_for_seed_or_new_admission_difficulty
tests.contract: An existing protected native notice uses ActionNonce without CAD1.

tests.name: test_12_sparse_selector_is_deterministic_unique_sorted_and_bounded
tests.contract: Actual SHA-256 selection uses at most kR hashes and O(k) entries.

tests.name: test_13_large_target_space_does_not_require_full_enumeration
tests.contract: A u64-sized abstract target space uses only the small sample map.

tests.name: test_14_forced_bounded_rejection_exhausts_and_has_no_nonce_fallback
tests.contract: Finite hash rejection reaches SelectionUnavailable at the bound.

tests.name: test_15_selector_edge_cases_and_invalid_parameters
tests.contract: N=1 and k=N work, invalid widths/counts are rejected.

tests.name: test_16_countable_record_survives_consumption_and_cannot_exist_without_once
tests.contract: Consumed once is required for the accepted approval, not its negation.

tests.name: test_17_same_bond_positions_or_key_rotation_do_not_add_votes
tests.contract: Native actor normalization and re-signing cannot multiply principals.

tests.name: test_18_one_full_approval_does_not_wait_for_nonresponders_or_shorten_window
tests.contract: One eligible completed actor can satisfy the existing minimum after all other conditions.

tests.name: test_19_individual_samples_do_not_replace_common_coverage
tests.contract: Personal sample completion cannot fill absent mandatory common targets.

tests.name: test_20_local_scope_is_not_promoted_to_full_replay
tests.contract: LocalHolds contributes no full-replay approval.

tests.name: test_21_same_slot_different_signed_body_is_conflict_not_automatic_slash
tests.contract: Byte/body disagreement alone does not prove equivocation or copying.

tests.name: test_22_invalid_signature_or_opening_does_not_poison_the_honest_slot
tests.contract: Invalid traffic cannot consume another actor's duty, funds or Q.

tests.name: test_23_flat_body_digest_target_digest_length_and_chunk_root_are_all_bound
tests.contract: A valid header is not a substitute for authenticated body contents.

tests.name: test_24_expected_targets_reject_missing_extra_duplicate_and_wrong_order
tests.contract: Challenge positions cannot be substituted or counted twice.

tests.name: test_25_own_context_can_use_shared_public_openings_without_proving_labor
tests.contract: Re-authenticated correct public witnesses may pass; physical replay is not inferred.

tests.name: test_26_nonce_salted_trace_is_not_the_original_miner_root
tests.contract: Outer nonce never changes the canonical integer trace leaf.

tests.name: test_27_chunk_tree_empty_single_padded_and_exact_merkle_openings
tests.contract: The specified chunk domains, index directions and padding authenticate bytes.

tests.name: test_28_partial_bundle_missing_or_mixed_chunks_never_counts_as_complete
tests.contract: Partial transport is authenticated staging, not an approval or receipt.

tests.name: test_29_chunk_retries_and_restart_are_idempotent_and_completion_checks_flat_digest
tests.contract: Canonical fragments share one body and one native submission.

tests.name: test_30_staging_qualification_capacity_and_deadline_are_finite
tests.contract: Staging headers cannot mint votes, restart clocks or allocate unbounded parts.

tests.name: test_31_sample_external_refutation_after_positive_needs_no_new_seed_or_ticket
tests.contract: A selected actor may correct a full affirmation with an off-sample negative.

tests.name: test_32_qualified_third_party_refutation_and_negative_budget_survive_positive_work
tests.contract: Public qualification and the protected negative reserve are separate from positive nonces.

tests.name: test_33_positive_retries_do_not_clear_pending_cases_or_infer_computation_guilt
tests.contract: An unresolved qualified notice blocks success even with valid positives.

tests.name: test_34_invalid_counterevidence_does_not_close_q_or_consume_negative_duty
tests.contract: A bad response or non-refuting witness only rejects that packet.

tests.name: test_35_refutation_wins_over_all_positive_records_and_same_batch_final
tests.contract: A valid local counterexample cannot be overturned by positive count.

tests.name: test_36_local_holds_does_not_inherit_full_claim_false_affirmation_liability
tests.contract: A local true relation is not a claim-wide affirmation.

tests.name: test_37_objective_liability_and_repeat_refutation_settle_once
tests.contract: Native finite liability needs an accepted full subject and exact root refutation.

tests.name: test_38_liability_backing_cannot_be_released_while_window_or_case_remains
tests.contract: Collateral stays through the finite native liability period and unresolved due.

tests.name: test_39_nonce_completion_mints_no_entitlement_and_native_reward_once_is_separate
tests.contract: A new submission identifier cannot create or redirect an economic right.

tests.name: test_40_success_payment_requires_final_and_keeps_full_replay_scope
tests.contract: Existing success entitlement cannot be redeemed from nonce/local completion alone.

tests.name: test_41_cancel_prune_and_missing_restore_do_not_revive_consumed_obligation
tests.contract: Raw evidence removal is separate from canonical once/tombstone state.

tests.name: test_42_restart_preserves_context_once_pending_and_economic_state
tests.contract: A fresh local process preserves native state rather than inferring it from cache.

tests.name: test_43_reorg_undo_is_atomic_and_old_worker_generation_is_stale
tests.contract: Canonical rollback undoes once/funds/coverage together without a permanent local spent file.

tests.name: test_44_batch_failure_rolls_back_all_canonical_effects_but_not_real_ingress_cost
tests.contract: Atomic batch semantics do not leave partial approval/receipt effects.

tests.name: test_45_old_claim_profile_remains_pinned_and_new_route_cannot_downgrade
tests.contract: Activation/config changes do not reinterpret an accepted claim's scope.

tests.name: test_46_missing_funding_or_finite_liability_prevents_countable_full_approval
tests.contract: Hash agreement alone does not establish native funds or responsibility.

tests.name: test_47_global_capacity_and_ingress_do_not_expand_with_model_aliases
tests.contract: Opaque model names grant neither new duty nor private capacity.

tests.name: test_48_local_sampling_can_miss_corruption_so_no_independent_labor_or_unconditional_safety_claim
tests.contract: The model explicitly exhibits the nonce-only guarantee limit.

tests.name: test_49_response_phase_step_uses_the_fixed_case_budget_and_no_new_seed
tests.contract: A finite native response has its own action nonce without clearing Q or minting another trial.

assumptions: All limits, clocks, funds, amounts, fees and capacities are synthetic fixture values, not protocol defaults or measurements.
Native identity/inner codec/absence/authentication/selection/actor eligibility/actual capital provenance are trusted adapters.
The 64-byte native-seed fixture preserves width and bytes; actual beacon unpredictability, bias resistance and anchoring are not established.
The toy integer relation and trace Merkle codec are not native LLM kernels; only outer CPN1 framing, SHA-256, selector and chunk commitment are direct RFC constructions.
The model keeps qualified native duties, cost/funding and finite liability fixtures; full RFC-0055 actor/service/deadline planner and actual coin/journal primitives are external.
Shared-material bytes and local target coverage are separate from full-replay attestations and native payment/once records.
The model-alias test checks pinned original identity and shared ingress capacity, not real registry throughput or storage performance.
not_verified: Native route coverage, production codecs/signature domains, RPC/UI/Studio, DB/snapshot/IBD and native atomic persistence.
Actual full LLM replay, truthful independent Panel work, physical labor, non-collusion or an active-honest-party guarantee.
Native beacon/assignment security, real canonical clock/service/censorship and carrier inclusion.
Minimum-node CPU/RAM/I/O, model registry scale, actual hostile network throughput, calibrated cost reservations or sustained 1 BPS.
Native economic sanctions, amounts, distribution and activation: liability and entitlement events here are explicit synthetic adapters.

limitations: No historical baseline or checker was updated to hide pre-existing failures.
Abstract native identity/cryptography/finance/clock/qualification are explicit fixture adapters.
Passing local samples and nonce binding do not establish independent full replay, active honest coverage, non-collusion, or physical labor.
No native end-to-end, minimum-node/registry/IBD performance, or sustained 1 BPS test was run.
